decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to cast Show and Tell, putting either an Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play and overwhelming the opponent. The deck includes cards like Sneak Attack, Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Spell Pierce to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With the help of mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to win the game through powerful and explosive plays.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck revolves around fast and explosive combo plays using cards like Animate Dead, Dark Ritual, and Reanimate to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The Fantasticar acts as a key piece in the combo, alongside support cards like Lotus Petal and Faithless Looting to enable quick and efficient plays. Thoughtseize and Unmask help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while the inclusion of Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers and Archon of Cruelty provide additional win conditions. The mana base is streamlined for consistency and efficiency.

The deck focuses on utilizing Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to bring key artifacts like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and The Filigree Sylex into play. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while Pinnacle Emissary and Loki, God of Mischief provide additional support. The deck aims to create a powerful artifact-based combo engine, supported by cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal for fast mana. The inclusion of cards like Sewer-veillance Cam and Skateboard offer additional utility and potential win conditions. The strategy revolves around efficiently assembling and leveraging powerful artifacts to overwhelm opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up a board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cheap and efficient cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Cori-Steel Cutter, and Murktide Regent, supported by strong control elements such as Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to pressure opponents and maintain tempo advantage. With a focus on early aggression and disruptive plays, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can establish their own game plan. This UR Tempo deck excels at applying pressure while keeping opponent's on the back foot.

The deck utilizes a combination of creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Goblin Engineer, and Goblin Welder, along with artifacts such as Mishra's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Lotus Petal to quickly set up a strong board presence. The key strategy revolves around using these cards to bring out powerful artifacts like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Phyrexian Dragon Engine, and The Filigree Sylex to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's combo potential.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly dump powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to overwhelm the opponent. It combines various discard spells like Unmask and Thoughtseize to get rid of possible threats from the opponent's hand. The use of fast mana with Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual allows for explosively fast plays. The presence of disruptive creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the game while setting up for a game-winning combo.

This deck aims to quickly cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It utilizes fast mana acceleration and carefully chosen spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own game-winning combo. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with huge threats early in the game, before they have a chance to establish their own board presence. It seeks to win the game in just a few turns by executing its combo efficiently and effectively.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the pieces needed for a powerful explosive combo using cards like Dark Ritual and Force of Will to protect key pieces. The Fantasticar is a crucial card that helps set up big plays and generate card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze while keeping up with card selection and tempo with cards like Ponder and Brainstorm. Overall, the deck is focused on fast-paced, high-risk, high-reward gameplay centered around the combo potential of The Fantasticar.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also utilizes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to close out the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to support the color requirements of the deck. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, protect your own threats, and out-value the opponent with powerful card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Quantum Riddler.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then reanimate them for a game-winning combo. By using cards like Faithless Looting, Unmask, and Thoughtseize to discard creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, the deck can efficiently set up the graveyard for reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes additional disruption with Cabal Therapy and Collective Brutality to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own combos.

This deck revolves around using The Fantasticar to combo off and win the game with a Doomsday pile, which can be achieved quickly through various cantrips, acceleration, and disruption. The key is to carefully plan out your Doomsday pile and protect it with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze while digging for the necessary pieces. The deck aims to win as fast as possible, putting pressure on the opponent and disrupting their game plan. It requires skillful sequencing and precise decision-making to execute the combo successfully.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures and disrupting their game plan with cards like Trinisphere and Chancellor of the Annex. It also utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to play powerful spells ahead of curve. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows the deck to tutor for artifact hate cards and shut down opponent's strategies. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through aggressive plays and resource denial.

The deck focuses on utilizing Aluren to combo off and play multiple creatures for free, while also enabling the player to cheat big creatures into play with Show and Tell. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to further enhance the combo potential. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and consistency in the deck's gameplan. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and card advantage.

The main idea behind this Legacy Aluren Combo deck is to quickly and efficiently assemble the card combo of Aluren along with creatures like Acererak the Archlich and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to generate a powerful advantage. By utilizing cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience, the deck aims to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy, making it a versatile and dynamic deck to play with.

This UWx Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Spell Snare, while also gaining card advantage with Narset, Parter of Veils and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck seeks to stabilize the board using powerful threats like True-Name Nemesis and Murktide Regent, and then ultimately win the game through card advantage and superior board control. The mana base is streamlined to maximize consistency and allow for efficient use of disruptive lands like Wasteland.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize Tibalt's Trickery in combination with various cascade spells and powerful creatures to disrupt opponents and quickly assemble a win condition. By consistently cascading into high impact spells like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Apex Devastator, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast and unpredictable plays. The deck also includes lands that can produce multiple colors of mana to support its diverse array of spells.
